result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but there are a few layout problems: some horizontally scrollable content is awkwardly clipped, and the fixed bottom navigation appears to cover feed content.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant feed content. The lower restaurant card image continues underneath the nav area, making the content feel cut off and partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content equal to the height of the bottom navigation so the last visible card is not obscured.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right edge, showing only a blank partial pill after “Healthy.” This looks like an unfinished or broken chip rather than an intentional carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Either ensure the next chip is partially visible with readable text, add right padding, or hide the overflow more cleanly.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel cuts off the third restaurant card quite abruptly, including its title, which makes the item look broken or incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card widths, spacing, or scroll snapping so partially visible cards still look intentional, or show a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance.
